No adverse effects were noted1 in a 6-month- old breast-fed infant whose 26-year-old mother had been taking methylphenidate 40 mg twice daily for about 5 weeks. Despite the relatively high milk-to-plasma ratio of 2.7 the relative infant dose was low, at 0.2% of the maternal dose. Nonetheless the au- thors recommended caution when giving methylphenidate to breast-feeding mothers. Licensed product information also rec- ommends that methylphenidate should be used with caution or avoided during breast feeding. 1. Hackett
